GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 123 (11 Jan 46) ESS/FI
(SCAPIN - 577)
APO 500
11 January 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : Imperial Japanese Government
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo
SUBJECT : Purchase by the Japanese Government of Foreign Currencies
1. Reference is made to C.L.O. Memorandum No. 1410 (5.1) dated 27 December 1945.
2. The request of the Imperial Japanese Government for permission to purchase notes of the Bank of Chosen, the Bank of Taiwan, the Central Bank of Manchukuo and United States Currency brought into Japan by repatriates prior to imposition of import and export controls is not approved.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
/s/ H. W. Allen
/t/ H. W. ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst. Adjutant General
